notes: This catalogue contains every active WCAG 2.2 success criterion. Each one has an automated rule (agent_access/rules, listed in automated_checks) and manual_checks: what an agent or human tester must judge, or, for a measured rule (detection_method automated), how to confirm the measurement covered the page.
The AA target includes A and AA criteria. AAA criteria remain in the catalogue with in_target_scope=false.

implementation_status, detection_method, and automated_checks are generated by python -m agent_access.catalogue.sync. manual_checks is seeded from the rule's docstring once and can then be edited here.
Do not treat an unimplemented or unassessed criterion as passing.
Full conformance also requires evaluating WCAG conformance requirements, full pages, and complete processes.

rules.title: Non-text Content
manual_checks: Judge whether each image's text alternative conveys its purpose, and that decorative images are hidden.

rules.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: For audio-only, is there a transcript? For video-only (no sound), a transcript or audio track?

rules.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Confirm captions exist and are accurate (track, CC button in the player, or burned-in).

rules.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Confirm each video has audio description or a full text alternative (transcript).

rules.title: Captions (Live)
manual_checks: For live video (streams), confirm real-time captions.

rules.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Confirm audio description for prerecorded video whose visuals carry information not in the audio.

rules.title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Confirm sign language interpretation for prerecorded audio in video.

rules.title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Where pauses are too short for audio description, confirm extended audio description.

rules.title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
manual_checks: Confirm a full text alternative (transcript with visual descriptions) for every prerecorded video.

rules.title: Audio-only (Live)
manual_checks: For live audio-only content, confirm a text alternative (e.g. live transcript).

rules.title: Info and Relationships
manual_checks: Judge whether headings, lists, tables, and form groupings in the markup match the visual structure.

rules.title: Meaningful Sequence
manual_checks: Compare the screen-reader reading order with the visual order (screenshot); flag where meaning changes.

rules.title: Sensory Characteristics
manual_checks: Check instructions don't rely only on shape, colour, size, location, or sound.

rules.title: Orientation
manual_checks: If the orientation check is inconclusive, read its evidence (text length and any 'rotate your device' message in portrait and landscape) with get_criterion; if it never ran, call rerun_check. Take a screenshot and use inspect_element on the main layout container to look for CSS that locks orientation (transform: rotate on the body, an overlay shown by an orientation media query). Record fail only if content or a message blocks one orientation; otherwise record pass with the evidence.

rules.title: Identify Input Purpose
manual_checks: For fields collecting the user's own personal data, judge whether a correct autocomplete token is set.

rules.title: Identify Purpose
manual_checks: Judge whether the purpose of UI components, icons, and regions can be programmatically determined.

rules.title: Use of Color
manual_checks: Judge from the screenshot whether colour is the only way information is conveyed (links, errors, required fields, charts).

rules.title: Audio Control
manual_checks: If the check could not tell whether media plays sound automatically, use inspect_element on each video, audio, and embedded player (autoplay, muted, controls attributes; for iframes, autoplay and mute parameters in src). Take a screenshot to look for a visible pause, stop, or mute control near the media. Record fail only if something autoplays with sound for over 3 seconds and has no control; needs_review with the reason if it can only be settled by playing the media.

rules.title: Contrast (Minimum)
manual_checks: Text that the check measured by pixel sampling (over images or gradients) is listed as needs_review with its ratio. Take a screenshot, use inspect_element on those elements for their colour, font size, and weight, and judge whether the text is readable against its real background. Record fail if the sampled ratio is clearly below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) on the screenshot; pass if the background behind the text is solid and the ratio holds; needs_review with the reason otherwise.

rules.title: Resize Text
manual_checks: If the zoom check is inconclusive or never ran, call rerun_check. Read its evidence: text clipped, lost off-screen, or not scaling at 200%. Use inspect_element on the elements it names to confirm they hold real content (not decorative or duplicated text) and take a screenshot to see whether the content is still reachable another way. Record fail for lost content or function; pass when nothing is lost.

rules.title: Images of Text
manual_checks: Judge from the screenshot whether any image shows text that could be real text (logos exempt).

rules.title: Contrast (Enhanced)
manual_checks: The check measured text contrast against the 7:1 (4.5:1 large text) AAA thresholds. Confirm it covered text over images or gradients, placeholder text, and text revealed on hover or focus; use take_screenshot and inspect_element on anything listed as unmeasured.

rules.title: Low or No Background Audio
manual_checks: For prerecorded speech audio, check background sound is off, can be turned off, or is 20 dB quieter.

rules.title: Visual Presentation
manual_checks: Check users can choose foreground and background colours; text isn't justified; line spacing is at least 1.5; text resizes to 200% without horizontal scrolling.

Lines the check measured as longer than 80 characters (40 for CJK) are needs_review. The criterion only requires that a mechanism is available to keep lines within the limit: if narrowing the browser window (or a page setting) reflows these lines to 80 characters or fewer, it passes. Otherwise judge whether they are blocks of reading text (fail) or exempt content such as code or tables.

rules.title: Images of Text (No Exception)
manual_checks: Judge whether any image of text exists that isn't pure decoration or essential (e.g. a logo).

rules.title: Reflow
manual_checks: If the reflow check reports horizontal scrolling that may be an allowed exception, use inspect_element on the overflowing elements it names and take a screenshot. Data tables, images, maps, code blocks, and toolbars that need two dimensions are exempt; text, navigation, and forms are not. Record fail if non-exempt content forces horizontal scrolling at 320px; pass if only exempt content does.

rules.title: Non-text Contrast
manual_checks: Control boundaries, icons, and meaningful graphics need 3:1; judge charts and graphics from the screenshot.

rules.title: Text Spacing
manual_checks: If the text-spacing check is inconclusive or never ran, call rerun_check and read which elements clipped their text. Use inspect_element on them for fixed heights or overflow: hidden, and judge whether the clipped text carried meaning. Record fail when content or function is lost with the WCAG spacing values; pass when nothing is lost.

rules.title: Content on Hover or Focus
manual_checks: If the hover check found no triggers or is inconclusive, look at the accessibility tree and a screenshot for tooltips, mega-menus, custom dropdowns, or help pop-ups, then call test_hover_content with their selectors. Judge from its results: content shown on hover or focus must stay while the pointer moves onto it, stay until dismissed, and close with Escape when it covers other content. Record fail for a pop-up that breaks one of these; not_applicable if nothing appears on hover or focus.

rules.title: Keyboard
manual_checks: The check lists elements that look clickable but can't take focus, or that have click handlers but were never reached with Tab. Use inspect_element on each: a plain container that only delegates clicks to a link or button inside it is fine; a div or span that does something on click and has no keyboard equivalent is a failure. For menus, accordions, or custom widgets, call test_disclosures with their selectors. Record fail for functionality that only works with a mouse; pass when every listed element is a container or has a keyboard-reachable equivalent.

rules.title: No Keyboard Trap
manual_checks: If focus stayed inside an embedded frame, or a dialog neither closes with Escape nor shows a close button, use inspect_element on the frame or dialog and take a screenshot. A frame with its own controls (a player, a map) is a trap only if Tab never leaves it; a dialog needs Escape, a close button, or documented keys. Record fail for a real trap; needs_review with the reason if the frame is cross-origin and can't be inspected.

rules.title: Keyboard (No Exception)
manual_checks: Like 2.1.1 with no exception for path-dependent input (drawing, drag) - judge those.

rules.title: Character Key Shortcuts
manual_checks: Single-key shortcuts need a way to turn off or remap them, or must only work when the component has focus.

rules.title: Timing Adjustable
manual_checks: Time limits must be adjustable (turn off, adjust, or extend), unless real-time or essential.

rules.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
manual_checks: Moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating content needs pause/stop/hide.

rules.title: No Timing
manual_checks: At AAA, timing must not be part of the activity at all (except real-time events and media).

rules.title: Interruptions
manual_checks: Interruptions (alerts, updates, pop-ups) must be postponable or suppressible, except emergencies.

rules.title: Re-authenticating
manual_checks: After a session expires and the user signs in again, their data must be preserved.

rules.title: Timeouts
manual_checks: Users must be warned how long inactivity can last before data loss, unless data is kept 20+ hours.

rules.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
manual_checks: If the check saw a small area flash more than 3 times a second, or could not assess red flashes, use inspect_element on the animated elements, GIFs, and videos it names and take a screenshot. Blinking cursors and small spinners are below the threshold; a large banner, video, or background that flashes is not. Record fail only if you can see flashing content over a large area or a red flash; otherwise record needs_review with what a human must watch.

rules.title: Three Flashes
manual_checks: The check sampled frames of the loaded page for flashing. Confirm from a screenshot and the media list that nothing flashes more than three times in any second: video, GIFs, canvas, CSS animations, and content that only plays on interaction or later.

rules.title: Animation from Interactions
manual_checks: Motion triggered by interaction must be disableable (e.g. honour prefers-reduced-motion).

rules.title: Bypass Blocks
manual_checks: There must be a way to skip repeated blocks (skip link, landmarks, or headings).

rules.title: Page Titled
manual_checks: Judge whether the page title describes the page's topic or purpose.

rules.title: Focus Order
manual_checks: Judge whether the Tab order preserves meaning; dialogs must manage focus.

rules.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
manual_checks: Judge whether each link's purpose is clear from its text plus its context (sentence, list item, heading).

rules.title: Multiple Ways
manual_checks: More than one way to find pages (nav, search, site map, index), except process steps.

rules.title: Headings and Labels
manual_checks: Judge whether headings and labels describe their topic or purpose.

rules.title: Focus Visible
manual_checks: If the check couldn't assess focus inside embedded frames, or found elements that take focus while invisible or off-screen, use inspect_element on them. A hidden element that receives focus (a skip link that appears on focus is fine; an off-screen menu item that never appears is not) is a failure. For frames, record needs_review with the reason if they are cross-origin. Record fail when a focused element has no visible indicator; pass when every focus stop is visible.

rules.title: Location
manual_checks: Users can tell where they are in a set of pages (breadcrumb, current-page indicator, site map).

rules.title: Link Purpose (Link Only)
manual_checks: The check looked for links with no text and links with vague text (click here, more, read more). Confirm from the page outline's link list that every link's text alone (with its accessible name) says where it leads; several links with the same text leading to different places, or texts that need surrounding context, fail at AAA.

rules.title: Section Headings
manual_checks: At AAA, content should be organised with section headings.
Text styled to look like a heading (bold or large) but not marked up as one is needs_review: judge whether it introduces a section; if so it should be a real heading.

rules.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
manual_checks: If the check is inconclusive or never ran, call rerun_check and read which focused elements were covered and by what. Use inspect_element on the covering element (sticky header, cookie banner, chat widget) and the focused element, and take a screenshot. Record fail if a focused element is entirely hidden by other content; pass when none is.

rules.title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
manual_checks: The check focused every Tab stop and measured whether sticky or fixed content covered any part of it. Confirm from its details and a screenshot that no fixed content (headers, footers, banners, chat widgets) hides any part of a focused control at AAA.

rules.title: Focus Appearance
manual_checks: At AAA, the focus indicator must be at least a 2px perimeter with 3:1 contrast between focused and unfocused.

rules.title: Pointer Gestures
manual_checks: Multipoint or path-based gestures need a single-pointer alternative.

rules.title: Pointer Cancellation
manual_checks: If the pointer check is inconclusive, use inspect_element on the elements with mousedown, pointerdown, or touchstart handlers to see what they do. Dragging and drawing legitimately start on the down-event; an action (navigation, submit, delete) that completes on the down-event with no way to abort does not. Record fail for such an action; pass when down-event handlers only start a drag or wait for release.

rules.title: Label in Name
manual_checks: If the check could not compare visible labels with announced names (no focusable controls were reached, or names came from an emulated screen reader), use the accessibility tree and inspect_element on buttons, links, and form fields that have visible text. The accessible name must contain the visible label text, in the same order. Record fail for a control whose aria-label or alt text does not contain its visible label; pass when every visible label is contained in its name.

rules.title: Motion Actuation
manual_checks: Functions triggered by device motion need a UI alternative and a way to turn motion off.

rules.title: Target Size (Enhanced)
manual_checks: The check measured every pointer target's size against 44 by 44 CSS px. Confirm from its details and a screenshot that it covered every control (including icon buttons, pagination, close buttons, controls in menus that only appear on hover), and that exempt targets (inline links in sentences, browser default controls) are the only ones below the size.

rules.title: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
manual_checks: Content must not restrict users to one input type (touch only, mouse only).

rules.title: Dragging Movements
manual_checks: Anything done by dragging must also work with a single pointer without dragging.

rules.title: Target Size (Minimum)
manual_checks: The check lists small native checkboxes or radio buttons that are exempt only at their browser-default size. Use inspect_element on them: a custom width or height, appearance: none, or a replacement control means they are not browser-default and must be 24x24 or spaced apart. Record fail for a styled control under 24x24 without enough spacing; pass when they are unstyled or large enough.

rules.title: Language of Page
manual_checks: The page's default language must be set (lang) and match its content.

rules.title: Language of Parts
manual_checks: Passages in another language must be marked with lang; judge Latin-script passages (e.g. French in English) yourself.

rules.title: Unusual Words
manual_checks: Judge whether jargon, idioms, or unusual words have definitions available (glossary, dfn, inline).

rules.title: Abbreviations
manual_checks: Abbreviations need an expansion (abbr title, first-use expansion, or glossary).

rules.title: Reading Level
manual_checks: Text needing more than lower-secondary reading ability needs a simpler version or supplement.

rules.title: Pronunciation
manual_checks: Where meaning depends on pronunciation (e.g. heteronyms, some CJK text), pronunciation must be available.

rules.title: On Focus
manual_checks: If the focus check is inconclusive or never ran, call rerun_check and read the evidence: elements that move focus away or try to navigate when they receive focus. Use inspect_element on them for onfocus handlers. Record fail when receiving focus alone opens a window, navigates, submits a form, or moves focus elsewhere; pass when Tab moved through the page without any of that.

rules.title: On Input
manual_checks: If the check could not change the form controls (no forms were found, or a form-like container has no <form>), call list_forms, then test_forms with the container's selector. Read whether changing a select, checkbox, or radio navigated or submitted. A select that navigates on change needs a visible instruction saying so, or a Go button. Record fail for an unannounced change of context; pass when changing controls caused none.

rules.title: Consistent Navigation
manual_checks: When only one page was audited, the automated comparison can't run. Record needs_review with that reason, and note from the accessibility tree whether the page has a navigation landmark that looks shared across the site. When several pages were audited, the check compares them itself at the end of the audit.

rules.title: Consistent Identification
manual_checks: Components with the same function must be identified consistently across pages.

rules.title: Change on Request
manual_checks: At AAA, context changes happen only on user request (no auto-redirects, unannounced new windows).

rules.title: Consistent Help
manual_checks: When only one page was audited, the automated comparison can't run. Look in the accessibility tree for help mechanisms (contact, help, chat, FAQ links) and record needs_review with that reason and the mechanisms found, so a human can compare their order on other pages. When several pages were audited, the check compares them itself at the end of the audit.

rules.title: Error Identification
manual_checks: The check says when a form tried to submit with no client-side message (server validation wasn't tested), or did nothing visible and has no required fields. Call list_forms and use inspect_element on the fields: required markers, aria-required, pattern, or type=email mean errors should be reported. For a form that validates only on the server, record needs_review with that reason. Record fail only when an input error was detected on the page (submission refused) and no text identified it; pass when errors were identified in text.

rules.title: Labels or Instructions
manual_checks: Inputs need visible labels or instructions (a placeholder alone is not enough).

rules.title: Error Suggestion
manual_checks: Judge whether error messages say how to fix the input.

rules.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
manual_checks: Legal, financial, data-changing, or test submissions must be reversible, checked, or confirmed.

rules.title: Help
manual_checks: At AAA, context-sensitive help (hints, examples, help links) should be available for inputs.

rules.title: Error Prevention (All)
manual_checks: At AAA, every submission must be reversible, checked, or confirmed.

rules.title: Redundant Entry
manual_checks: Information already entered in a process must be auto-filled or selectable, not re-typed.

rules.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
manual_checks: Sign-in must not need a cognitive test (remembering, transcribing, puzzles) without an alternative.

rules.title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
manual_checks: At AAA, no cognitive function test at all, including object recognition.

rules.title: Name, Role, Value
manual_checks: The check lists controls that show or hide content without exposing an expanded state, and any focusable element announced without a role or name. Use inspect_element on each for role, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-label, and the native element used; for menus and accordions call test_disclosures. A details/summary element and a link to another page are fine without aria-expanded; a custom toggle built on a div or button is not. Record fail for a custom control with no name, role, or state; pass when every listed control exposes them.

rules.title: Status Messages
manual_checks: Status messages (results, errors, progress) must be announced without moving focus (live regions/roles).
